I created **Breakfast Hours** (`rays-breakfast-hours`) in the `rays-hotel` set of `rays-design-library`. It's approved, so editors can use it now. It isn't on any hotel page yet.

**Times are placeholders.** You didn't give me the real breakfast times, so I used weekdays (Monday to Friday) 7:00 to 10:30 and weekends (Saturday and Sunday) 8:00 to 11:30. Every text on the card, including the day labels and times, can be edited on each page. Send me the real times and I'll update the defaults.

**Look:** It copies the Seasonal Offer's layout and styling: the same dark brown background, Georgia headings, 50px title, uppercase eyebrow in the accent color, and pill-shaped button. Where the Seasonal Offer has its image, this card has a coffee cup icon drawn in the accent color.

**Content:**
- Eyebrow "Good morning" and title "Breakfast is served".
- The weekday and weekend times side by side, each marked with a thin bar in the accent color. Showing them side by side keeps the card within the compact height the hotel pages need.

**Settings** (in a "Breakfast" group):
- **Accent color:** defaults to `#f08a3c`, the same as the Seasonal Offer.
- **Button label:** defaults to "See the menu".

**Things to know:**
- **The button doesn't link anywhere.** It's just a label, like the "Book now" button on the Seasonal Offer. I can add a configurable link if you want one.
- **The eyebrow is slightly below the size rule.** It's 22px to match the Seasonal Offer, while the hotel page rules ask for at least 26px for body text. Everything else meets the rules: day labels are 26px, times 32px and the title 50px.

Do you want me to add it to the Madrid and London home pages?
